analytics.name: Analytic 2053
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a network infrastructure configuration change that results in a communication gap between previously-connected Industrial Control System (ICS) zones, from a source not in the approved network administration list. This technique-level analytic synthesizes Serial COM (T1695.001), Ethernet (T1695.002), and Wi-Fi (T1695.003). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

tuning.description: IP ranges authorized for network infrastructure configuration changes.
Scheduled maintenance periods during which connectivity-affecting changes are authorized.
Time window correlating a configuration change with subsequent communication loss.
